title: cloud: when the release carrying #32527 rolls out, run the existing stored-expression fill once across hosted tenants, so totals over formulas already turned into stored fields stop reading low
body:
coordinator#1 · marchtian · session_017ihL2dYynaMYbZTr8hTeRC

Filing gate: ③ maintainer's direct task, verbatim (project thread, 2026-11-12T07:10Z): 「两张 cloud 卡，你直接写，挂 cloud 标签就可以」. It carries out the "With it" line of the ruling on #32527 (ruling record comment 6816429574, letter A, maintainer 「同意」 at 2026-11-12T06:23Z), which rests on his remark 「老数据是空的（最严重），托管的用户也可以云端统一安排升级」. That ruling recorded this card as owed by the cloud PM; it is filed here on his instruction. ⛔ Not a claim.
Reader: the `repo:cloud` seat, at the rollout of the first cloud pin that contains #32527's merge. The work is cloud's upgrade or operations path, not objectstack code.
Dedupe (open AND closed): `stored-expressions in:title,body` → 24 hits, `stored expression sweep tenants` → 18, `backfill stored expression hosted` → 15; none asks for a hosted sweep. objectstack-ai/cloud was not searched from this session (outside its repository scope).
Blocked-by: #32527

## Business reason

#32443 (ruled B) makes a computed value totallable through a stored field: a field of the value's return type carrying the same `expression`, computed on every write and kept in a column. PR #32545 makes every refusal of a total over a formula point authors and the AI there. An app that already has rows and follows that remedy gets the new field `NULL` on every existing row, so a dataset `sum` reads 0 or low with no error (measured on #32527: true value 6, read 0; earlier on hotclm, #29961: 121 of 121 rows `NULL`).

#32527 (A) closes this for every change made after it ships: the save or publish that adds a stored computed field, changes its expression, or turns a formula into one fills the existing rows itself. It does nothing for rows left empty by changes made BEFORE the hosted tenant ran that version. Those stay `NULL` until someone fills them, and a hosted tenant has no way to (the command needs a direct database URL). This card is that one-time cleanup.

Who benefits: hosted customers whose builder or AI changed a formula into a stored field, or added a stored expression to a populated object, between now and the rollout. Without it, their reports keep reading low indefinitely, and nobody sees an error.

## Ask

1. When cloud rolls out the first objectstack pin that contains #32527's merge, run the existing fill once per hosted tenant environment, for every object that declares a stored `expression`. The fill is the engine's `backfillStoredExpressions` (`packages/objectql/src/stored-expression-backfill.ts`), the same computation the write uses. Its one caller today is `os migrate stored-expressions` (`packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/stored-expressions.ts`); calling the function from cloud's upgrade path, or the command against each tenant database, are both fine. Cloud chooses.
2. Fill only missing values (`--apply` without `--changed`, which writes the values still `NULL`). If cloud can tell which tenants changed an existing stored expression's body before the rollout, `--changed` is the fill for those.
3. Record the result per tenant: objects and fields filled, row counts, and any row the computation refused. Post the totals on this card.
4. Pin probe before running: `git merge-base --is-ancestor <#32527's squash sha on main> <sha in cloud's .objectstack-sha>`, run in an objectstack checkout.

## Acceptance notes

- After the run, re-measure one tenant that holds a field of this shape: the dataset `sum` over it equals the sum of the values the expression gives.
- The boot warning (`announceStoredExpressionHoles` in `stored-expression-backfill.ts`, called from `packages/objectql/src/plugin.ts`) reports no holes on the tenants that were filled.
- A run is once per rollout. A sweep on a timer is not the ask; A ruled out a fill on a schedule as the main mechanism (#32527, option B).

Related: #32527 (the platform fill this rides on), #32443, PR #32545, #29961 (the fill and the command), the cloud builder card filed alongside this one.
